hook.name: ZoraV4CoinHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for Zora Coins that initializes multiple Doppler-curve liquidity positions on pool creation. On every swap, collects LP fees, converts them to a backing currency, and distributes rewards. Features a dynamic launch fee decaying from 99% to 1% over 10 seconds post-creation, and triggers Zora limit order book fills on each swap.
